scope: source-level ABI and caller review only; runtime, ownership and threading admission remain separate gates

findings.evidence: stream.cpp allocates and frees ThreadLocalStream handles and resolves a concrete stream for the current thread; mlx-rs/src/stream.rs has no caller of the new functions
findings.decision: defer a public thread-local stream abstraction until separate ownership and cross-thread admission

findings.evidence: vector.cpp owns std::vector<Stream> behind a new/free handle and copies elements through mlx_vector_stream_get; no mlx-rs caller uses this family
findings.decision: defer enumeration and vector ownership as one cohort

findings.evidence: mlx_clear_streams calls mlx::core::clear_streams; existing Rust handles have no lifetime relation to that registry mutation
findings.decision: intentionally leave registry destruction unexposed; defer default synchronization to a synchronization cohort

findings.evidence: io_types.h changes seek from void to int and read/read_at_offset/write from void to size_t; private/io.h rejects negative seek status and short byte counts; mlx-rs does not construct mlx_io_vtable callbacks
findings.decision: defer custom I/O adapters; generated mlx-sys bindings pick up the ABI change without a high-level rebind
